title: RAG · Overview
description: The shared RAG platform in namespace rag (mrjithendar/moks-rag): what runs, who calls it, what it did and what it uses.

options.content: The shared retrieval platform behind jithendar.com's projects: **rag-api** (`/rag`) and **Open WebUI** (`/chat`) in front of **Qdrant** (vectors), **bge-m3** (embeddings), **docling-serve** (document parsing) and **LiteLLM** (Claude models). None of them exports metrics yet, so traffic comes from the Istio sidecars, resources from cAdvisor and the kubelet, and operations from rag-api's log events. Source: [moks-rag](https://github.com/mrjithendar/moks-rag). One component in detail: [RAG · Components](/grafana/d/rag-components).

panels.title: Components
panels.description: Main container of each component, from cAdvisor: Running, or Down when it has not run for 5 minutes. Running is not ready: mk4 has no kube-state-metrics, so readiness is not recorded.

targets.expr: label_replace(count by (container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="rag", container=~"rag-api|open-webui|qdrant|ollama|docling-serve|litellm"}), "container", "bge-m3", "container", "ollama") or label_replace(vector(0), "container", "rag-api", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "container", "open-webui", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "container", "qdrant", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "container", "bge-m3", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "container", "docling-serve", "", "") or label_replace(vector(0), "container", "litellm", "", "")

panels.title: API requests
panels.description: Requests to rag-api in the time range, from any caller: the gateway (jithendar.com/rag), Open WebUI and services in other namespaces. Kubernetes' probes do not pass the sidecar and are not counted.

targets.expr: sum((increase(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="rag-api"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="rag-api"}[$__range]) unless istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="rag-api"} offset $__range) or increase(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="rag-api"}[$__range])) or (increase(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", destination_service_namespace="rag", response_flags=~".*(UH|UF|UO|NR).*", destination_service_name="rag-api"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", destination_service_namespace="rag", response_flags=~".*(UH|UF|UO|NR).*", destination_service_name="rag-api"}[$__range]) unless istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", destination_service_namespace="rag", response_flags=~".*(UH|UF|UO|NR).*", destination_service_name="rag-api"} offset $__range) or increase(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", destination_service_namespace="rag", response_flags=~".*(UH|UF|UO|NR).*", destination_service_name="rag-api"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: Chat UI requests
panels.description: Requests to Open WebUI (jithendar.com/chat) in the time range: pages, assets, its API and WebSocket upgrades. One chat is many requests; Chat answers below counts the answers.

targets.expr: sum((increase(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="open-webui"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="open-webui"}[$__range]) unless istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="open-webui"} offset $__range) or increase(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="open-webui"}[$__range])) or (increase(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", destination_service_namespace="rag", response_flags=~".*(UH|UF|UO|NR).*", destination_service_name="open-webui"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", destination_service_namespace="rag", response_flags=~".*(UH|UF|UO|NR).*", destination_service_name="open-webui"}[$__range]) unless istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", destination_service_namespace="rag", response_flags=~".*(UH|UF|UO|NR).*", destination_service_name="open-webui"} offset $__range) or increase(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", destination_service_namespace="rag", response_flags=~".*(UH|UF|UO|NR).*", destination_service_name="open-webui"}[$__range]))) or vector(0)

panels.title: API p95
panels.description: 95th percentile of rag-api's response time in the time range. A chat answer streams: its time runs to the end of the answer.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) ((increase(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="rag-api", response_code!="101"}[$__range]) + (min_over_time(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="rag-api", response_code!="101"}[$__range]) unless istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="rag-api", response_code!="101"} offset $__range) or increase(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="rag-api", response_code!="101"}[$__range]))))

panels.title: Vector storage
panels.description: Used space on Qdrant's 15 GiB Hetzner volume (collections sre_knowledge, cms_content, seo_intel). Points per collection need Qdrant's own /metrics, which Prometheus does not scrape yet.

targets.expr: max(kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubernetes-kubelet", namespace="rag", persistentvolumeclaim=~"qdrant-storage-.*"})

panels.title: Since last start
panels.description: Time since the most recently started main container started: a rollout, a restart or a crash. The purple marks on the graphs say which one.

targets.expr: time() - max(container_start_time_seconds{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="rag", container=~"rag-api|open-webui|qdrant|ollama|docling-serve|litellm"})

panels.title: Ingests
panels.description: rag-api `rag_ingest` log events in the time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="rag", container="rag-api"} | logfmt | event="rag_ingest" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Queries
panels.description: rag-api `rag_query` log events in the time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="rag", container="rag-api"} | logfmt | event="rag_query" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Chat answers
panels.description: rag-api `openai_chat_completions` log events in the time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="rag", container="rag-api"} | logfmt | event="openai_chat_completions" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Deletes
panels.description: rag-api `rag_delete_document` log events in the time range.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({namespace="rag", container="rag-api"} | logfmt | event="rag_delete_document" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: Operations
panels.description: rag-api's operations per bar, from its log events: ingests, queries, chat answers (each one a retrieval and a Claude call), deletes, and openai_list_models, Open WebUI asking which models exist.

targets.expr: sum by (event) (count_over_time({namespace="rag", container="rag-api"} | logfmt | event!~"http_request|application_log" [$__interval]))

panels.title: Requests/s from outside rag
panels.description: Who calls the platform: the gateway for jithendar.com/rag and /chat, and services in other namespaces once they connect (moks-sre, moks-cms, seo-agent). Counted by the receiving sidecar.

targets.expr: sum by (source_workload_namespace, source_workload, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", source_workload_namespace!="rag"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Calls between components
panels.description: Open WebUI → rag-api for chats; rag-api → bge-m3 (embed), Qdrant (search and store), docling-serve (parse files) and LiteLLM (answer). rag-api → Qdrant never drops to zero: rag-api's readiness probe checks Qdrant every 10 s.

targets.expr: sum by (source_workload, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", source_workload_namespace="rag"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Latency p95 by hop
panels.description: 95th percentile per caller and component, at the receiving sidecar. WebSocket upgrades (101) are left out: they last as long as the connection.

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, source_workload, destination_service_name) (rate(istio_request_duration_milliseconds_bucket{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag", response_code!="101"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.title: Responses by code
panels.description: Response codes per component, plus requests a caller could not get to a pod (UH: no healthy pod, UF: connection failed, UO: overflow, NR: no route). 302 and 401 at Open WebUI are its sign-in.

targets.expr: sum by (destination_service_name, response_code) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="destination", destination_service_namespace="rag"}[$__rate_interval]))

sum by (destination_service_name, response_code, response_flags) (rate(istio_requests_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", destination_service_namespace="rag", response_flags=~".*(UH|UF|UO|NR).*"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Traffic to the internet
panels.description: Bytes over connections that leave the mesh: LiteLLM to the Claude API, bge-m3 fetching its 1.16 GB model on a new volume, and whatever else a component downloads. TLS, so no requests or codes. Istio calls the response bytes sent, so downloaded is istio_tcp_sent_bytes_total.

targets.expr: sum by (source_workload) (rate(istio_tcp_sent_bytes_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", source_workload_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="PassthroughCluster"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (source_workload) (rate(istio_tcp_received_bytes_total{job="envoy-stats", reporter="source", source_workload_namespace="rag", destination_service_name="PassthroughCluster"}[$__rate_interval]))

panels.title: Memory of limit
panels.description: Working set of each main container over its memory limit. The kernel OOM-kills a container at 100%.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="rag", container=~"rag-api|open-webui|qdrant|ollama|docling-serve|litellm"}) / max by (container) (container_spec_memory_limit_bytes{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="rag", container=~"rag-api|open-webui|qdrant|ollama|docling-serve|litellm"} > 0), "container", "bge-m3", "container", "ollama")

panels.title: CPU by component
panels.description: Cores used by each main container. bge-m3 has no CPU limit: Ollama sizes its threads to the node and uses up to about 3.5 of its 4 cores while it embeds.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="rag", container=~"rag-api|open-webui|qdrant|ollama|docling-serve|litellm"}[$__rate_interval])), "container", "bge-m3", "container", "ollama")

panels.title: Memory by component
panels.description: Working set of each main container. bge-m3 holds its model (about 1.25 GiB) all the time.

targets.expr: label_replace(max by (container) (container_memory_working_set_bytes{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="rag", container=~"rag-api|open-webui|qdrant|ollama|docling-serve|litellm"}), "container", "bge-m3", "container", "ollama")

panels.title: CPU throttled
panels.description: Share of scheduling periods in which a container hit its CPU limit and waited. Slow answers with high throttling need a higher limit, not a faster model. bge-m3 has no limit and no series.

targets.expr: label_replace(sum by (container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_throttled_periods_total{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="rag", container=~"rag-api|open-webui|qdrant|ollama|docling-serve|litellm"}[$__rate_interval])) / sum by (container) (rate(container_cpu_cfs_periods_total{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="rag", container=~"rag-api|open-webui|qdrant|ollama|docling-serve|litellm"}[$__rate_interval])), "container", "bge-m3", "container", "ollama")

panels.title: Volumes
panels.description: Used share of each volume: Qdrant's collections (15 GiB) and bge-m3's model (10 GiB). Open WebUI's 2 GiB volume is on local-path storage, which the kubelet does not measure.

targets.expr: max by (persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_used_bytes{job="kubernetes-kubelet", namespace="rag"}) / max by (persistentvolumeclaim) (kubelet_volume_stats_capacity_bytes{job="kubernetes-kubelet", namespace="rag"})

panels.title: Network by component
panels.description: Bytes in and out of each pod, sidecar included. Every pod in the mesh receives about 8 to 15 kB/s even when idle (rag or not), so a component's own traffic is the rise above that.

targets.expr: sum by (component) (label_replace(rate(container_network_receive_bytes_total{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="rag"}[$__rate_interval]), "component", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}|-[0-9]+)"))

sum by (component) (label_replace(rate(container_network_transmit_bytes_total{job="kubernetes-cadvisor", namespace="rag"}[$__rate_interval]), "component", "$1", "pod", "(.+?)(?:-[a-z0-9]{8,10}-[a-z0-9]{5}|-[0-9]+)"))
